rules: Parse printed Time tokens and physical log line order; bind every mission and task ID, sequence, no-resource request and successful availability test to its source MTID and aircraft.
Exact physical order order/create/activate/allocate/preparation/task/subtask/performance/completion/launch/success/return/ready. Same-time line order is part of the gate.
No cross-recipe subtask, cancellation, abort, resource booking, item demand, shortage or physical aircraft identity substitution.
Terminal h36 aircraft ready and all mission/preparation/stock ledgers closed. Duplicate native ready diagnostic lines do not create another physical aircraft.

full_report_gate.strict: Compare exact table and column order, datatype/key metadata, instance names, row order, IDs, nulls and all 4,044 cells. Source and typed events determine physical states, mission/task counters, interval exposure and their time-weighted values. Five specifically declared System zero fields and item-free stock presentation are fixed bounded native-format expectations; do not claim statistical formulas for them or derive their values from the candidate report. Any other unknown physical/event formula or attribution is NO_GO.
full_report_gate.stock: For this exact item-free source and zero typed stock-demand ledger, every half-hour row has NBO=0, PNB=1, NDF=NDD=NDR=NDP=NLD=NWT=0 and NBOU=ROS=ROST=WT=WTT=WTS=null. PNB=1 is the no-backorder probability, not a physical stock count. Manual pp729–732 defines PNB and demand-conditioned ROS/ROST/WT; with no demands these are undefined/null. NBOU and WTS null are bounded native presentation conventions for this accepted item-free report profile, fixed here before checker construction, not a universal manual law. Require the same exact nulls in all 72 rows; do not infer expected values from the candidate report during replay.

fractional_time_weighted: SystemResults state occupancy and FTMO in bins crossed by printed non-source-exact event edges
elapsed_hours: time integrals formed from matched start/end events

full_report_gate.numeric_rule: For a genuinely fractional cell derive an absolute uncertainty before reading that cell: each printed event time token contributes half a unit of its last printed decimal place; add contributing endpoint uncertainties, divide by 0.5 h for an interval occupancy or by 36 h for a 36-hour mean, and add at most 5e-7 native serialization allowance. Elapsed hours use endpoint uncertainty without bin division. Source-scheduled exact h0,7,8,10,11,12,14,15,16,18,36 edges have zero timestamp uncertainty when typed source and event identity both establish them. Any computed bound exceeding 1.1e-4 for one half-hour occupancy is NO_GO; no clamping, report-value fitting or silent formula selection. Exact zero, whole-bin and discrete cells have zero tolerance. Any unknown physical, counter, occupancy or time-weighted formula or event attribution is NO_GO. The five explicitly mapped exact-zero System presentation fields and the separately declared empty-stock native presentation are fixed bounded format gates, not claimed statistical formulas; no other implicit format fallback is allowed.
full_report_gate.expected_hot_context: Hot missions and their report contributions remain required context; var01 cannot be established by omitting later rows.
full_report_gate.system_state_partition: For the one physical aircraft over h0–36: NSYRY 27 h (h0–7,10–11,14–15,18–36); NSYMP 5/6 h (h7–7.5,11–11+1/6,15–15+1/6); NSYMR 13/6 h (h7.5–8,11+1/6–12,15+1/6–16); NSYMO 6 h (h8–10,12–14,16–18). NSYMA=NSYMP+NSYMR+NSYMO=9 h; NSYA=36 h. Manual physical pp629–631 defines unassigned ready vs assigned and pp642–643 FTMO. Do not combine NSYRY and NSYMR.

full_report_gate.metadata_basis: Exact four instance names and column metadata are fixed from the accepted B03 native format. The checker independently constructs physical, count and time-weighted values from pinned source and typed events. Five System zero fields and declared item-free Stock null/PNB cells use the explicit bounded presentation map fixed in this contract, corroborated by manual/accepted B02 format context. No candidate numeric cell may be copied or used to choose a rule.

system_zero_field_basis.basis: The pinned source has one unfailing aircraft, ENPM=N, no stock/resource/repair/PM/reconfiguration/switch chain, and the complete typed log contains no fault, item demand, waiting, repair, PM, transport or switching event. These zero state/counter fields must be justified by those source and negative-event gates, not copied from the report.
system_zero_field_basis.presentation_basis: For exactly this one-aircraft, one-replication B03 report profile, all 72 rows have zero in these five SystemResults fields. Installed manual physical pp633-634,567-571,645-646 defines lower/upper percentiles and requested/accomplished System Time fields, but does not yield these zeros as source/event statistical formulas. Accepted B02 v1.0.2 report format independently corroborates zero presentation in ready and flying rows including NSYA=1/STACC=1. This is a fixed, exact native presentation convention only, not a general percentile, request-time or mission-fraction law; any nonzero here rejects.
system_zero_field_basis.SYDT_null_basis: With zero completed maintenance downtime periods (NSYDT=0), average completed downtime SYDT is undefined/null, consistent with installed manual physical pp645-646. SYDTU=0 remains only a bounded upper-percentile presentation convention.

B02_format_corroboration.role: accepted native format context only, not a B03 physical behavior parent or numeric oracle

negative_probes: Mutate COLD-FIRST MTID/task route or swap a cold INSPECT/SERVICE sequence; reject before report check.
Swap first and later HOT-SORTIE task identities or a same-time physical event line order; reject.
Move a cold step completion beyond its printed-time bound or alter an interior System count/zero/null/ID; reject.
Alter one fractional System cell beyond its predeclared endpoint bound; reject.
Change any StockTotalResults null to zero, add backorder/demand or mutate any summary fraction/count; reject.
Alter accepted input, parent diff, B02/A02 dependency, closure, invocation, one raw byte or published Git/local identity; reject.
Promote failed -01 validation or claim automatic thermal/history switch; reject as scope error.
Replace an NSYRY ready bin with NSYMR or preserve their sum while swapping labels; reject. Alter any of the six separately declared System state integrals; reject.
Change exact SystemResults/StockTotalResults instance_name or convert a no-demand stock null to zero, or PNB=1 to physical quantity 0; reject.

Change any of the five exact-zero bounded System presentation fields to a small nonzero value, or change SYDT null; reject without a numeric tolerance. Preserve physical NSYA=1 and STACC=1 flying-bin derivation separately.
